data.narrative:
Kestrel operates in the Defense & Security sector alongside a fragmented comp universe of 2 public peers (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private players, including Anduril Industries, Helsing, Castelion, Shield AI, and Saronic. The target's stage remains undisclosed, as does its current valuation and capital raised to date.

Peer-median triangulation proved inapplicable due to insufficient narrow peer density. While 26 same-sector Defense & Security peers exist in the dataset, none satisfied stage-matching, adjacent-stage, or valuation-tier filters necessary to generate three or more comparable datapoints. Applying an all-sector median would introduce material distortion given Defense & Security's distinct margin profile and customer concentration dynamics relative to broader tech. No alternative methodologies (DCF, revenue multiple, or asset-based approaches) were supported by the provided data.

The absence of viable quantitative triangulation leaves Kestrel's valuation range unsupported by the available evidence. A credible range would require either: disclosure of the target's stage and recent funding events to enable stage-adjusted peer matching; expansion of the comparable set to include less-adjacent defense or aerospace plays; or introduction of transaction multiples from recent Defense & Security M&A. The key uncertainty remains the scarcity of publicly observable comps at Kestrel's specific stage and scale within this sector.
